verdict.rationale: Insomnia ships an official, documented CLI (Inso CLI) for automating test execution and collection runs via existing workflows, which serves as the primary programmatic interface for driving the product (insomnia-docs-3, insomnia-probe-4). However, there is no evidence of a full documented public REST/GraphQL API for controlling the broader app (e.g., managing environments, mocks, or GitSync programmatically) — probes for an OpenAPI/swagger spec on the docs site returned 404s (insomnia-probe-3). Missing for 10: a comprehensive documented public API (not just a CLI) covering the full product surface, and independent verification of API completeness/reliability.
